name: ImgEdit-Bench
description: Held-out image-editing benchmark shipped with ImgEdit (sysuyy/ImgEdit). Evaluates instruction adherence, editing quality, and detail preservation across a basic suite, a challenging single-turn suite, and a multi-turn suite. The parent Hub repository also contains the 1.2M training corpus; only the Benchmark.tar split is the evaluation target here.

benchmark.notes: 734 basic-edit cases plus challenging and multi-turn suites, as reported in arXiv:2505.20275. The Hub repo also contains the 1.2M training set, which is not the evaluation split.

notes: Paper: arXiv:2505.20275. Code: https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/ImgEdit. Headline scores on this suite use a VLM judge on a 0-5 scale.
